bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears confirmed that backup quarterback Tyson Bagent will start Week 5 against the Green Bay Packers, as Caleb Williams will not return from his hamstring injury in Week 5 against the Green Bay Packers, as head coach Ben Johnson ruled him out for the upcoming rivalry matchup. Adding to the week's roster moves, the Chicago Bears have released Marcus Davenport from the practice squad , continuing an active offseason of transactions as Chicago looks to build on its recent winning momentum.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions' defense suffered fresh injury concerns after their Week 4 loss, as head coach Dan Campbell revealed Monday that Rock Ya-Sin and defensive lineman Tyleik Williams were injured against the Panthers, with Campbell saying Ya-Sin "doesn't look good right now" while Williams is "touch and go" and day-to-day . This comes on the heels of a rough defensive performance, as the Carolina Panthers offense scored 32 points against Detroit's struggling defense under coordinator Kelvin Sheppard , prompting the team to explore possible trade targets that could help save Sheppard's job after the disastrous 26-32 loss .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The biggest Packers story is the confirmed season-ending injury to linebacker Edgerrin Cooper, as the Green Bay Packers have gotten a worst-case injury update on linebacker Edgerrin Cooper after Sunday's game , with tests confirming a torn Achilles sustained during their win over Tampa Bay. The Packers managed to hold on for a 17-14 road win over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, though it wasn't exactly a performance to write home about, pushing the team back to .500 on the season , while the coaching staff now faces the challenge of replacing one of their top defensive playmakers.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings improved to 4-0 with a gritty 15-10 win over the Miami Dolphins, but the victory came at a steep cost on the offensive line. Starting guard Donovan Jackson went down with a knee injury and did not return, and coach Kevin O'Connell announced Jackson has a torn meniscus that will require surgery, ruling him out for the regular season ; additionally, left tackle Christian Darrisaw is now in concussion protocol after also exiting Sunday's game.
